answer: Propose a job lottery: each active ID buys at least one daily ticket, burning 1 token each; one ID may buy many. Jobs label images of copper parts, lantern faults and lotus disease. Validators check unique ID/day-bound burns, draw uniformly by ticket and check work against hidden labels; failed work earns nothing. Hardware is reusable; burns and power recur; no stake. Corrupt graders can fake results; ownership is not proved. Sharing hardware or bidding in parallel cannot reuse tickets: ten daily tickets burn 10 tokens, with identical odds under one ID or ten.
